@@U02500@@
Morning sun.
The EMPEROR, COURTIERS. 浮士德, and 梅菲斯特,
respectably dressed according to the fashion, kneel before the EMPEROR.

@@U02502@@
Sire, do you forgive us last night's fireworks?

@@U02504@@
(Beckoning them to rise.)

@@U02505@@
I could wish for many such entertainments.
Suddenly, like 普路托,
I saw myself in a glowing sphere
that burned all about me.
Before me out of a night black as coal,
appeared a rocky valley
aglow with tiny flares.
Out of many a pit surrounding me
swirled thousands of savage flames that soared on high
and, joining, formed a flickering vault of fire
that forever changed its shape.
And far in the distance,
I saw through its twisted columns of fire,
long processions of nations in motion,
converging on me in a wide circle,
to pay me homage as always.
I recognized one and another of my courtiers.
I appeared to myself a prince of a thousand salamanders.

@@U02507@@
And so you are, Sire, for each element
recognizes your Majesty's supremacy.
You've tested fire and proven it obedient,
now cast yourself into the sea at its roughest,
and scarcely will you have trod the pearl-strewn floor,
than pale green heaving waves edged with purple
will form about you a glorious round,
a lovely place to dwell,
with you its central point.
translation:
@@U02500@@
早晨的阳光。
皇帝，朝臣。 浮士德和梅菲斯特，
穿戴整齐，跪拜在皇帝面前。

@@U02502@@
陛下，您能原谅我们昨晚的烟火吗？

@@U02504@@
（示意他们起身。）

@@U02505@@
我希望有很多这样的娱乐活动。
突然，像普路托一样，
我看到自己在一个发光的球体中
那燃烧了我的一切。
在我面前，黑如煤炭的夜晚，
出现了一个岩石山谷
闪烁着微小的耀斑。
从我周围的许多坑中出来
数千道凶猛的火焰在高空盘旋
并结合在一起，形成了一个闪烁的火穹
永远改变了它的形状。
而在遥远的地方，
我透过它扭曲的火柱看到，
各国人民长长的游行队伍，
围成一个大圈向我汇聚，
一如既往地向我致敬。
我认出了我的一位又一位朝臣。
我对自己来说就像是一千只火蜥蜴的王子。

@@U02507@@
陛下，对于每一个元素，您都是如此
承认陛下的至高无上的地位。
你已经测试了火并证明它是服从的，
现在把自己扔进最汹涌的大海里，
你几乎不会踏过铺满珍珠的地板，
比带有紫色边缘的淡绿色波浪
将在你周围形成一个光荣的圆，
一个可爱的居住地，
以你为中心点。
